cards.title: Reporting and Traceability Requirements
cards.claim: Population PK reports must include executive summaries, detailed methods (model equations, software, handling of outliers/missing data), and results presented as effects on clinically relevant exposures. Datasets and model files must be traceable, with unique subject identifiers linking to clinical trial data. All conclusions must be reproducible with submitted codes and data.
conditions: Results should be presented as effects on exposure, not just model parameters.
Traceability between model output and E-R datasets is required.
Software and version must be reported.
required_inputs: Datasets used for model building and evaluation.
limitations: Lack of traceability hinders regulatory review.
cards.downstream_use: Preparing regulatory submissions; ensuring reproducibility of PK analyses.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
